description: Evidence-linked marriage structure plus a six-part partner profile (spouseProfile): when the relationship starts, someone new or known, where and in which direction from the person's current place, the partner's nature, work hints, and prior relationships. Every finding cites a located passage; questions the installed texts do not answer are marked unavailable. No deterministic outcome claims.

currentPlace.description: Where the person lives now, as they said it (for example 'Bangalore'). Directions are given relative to it. Never pass the birthplace in its place.

place.description: Catalogue query or display label when explicit coordinates are supplied

timezone.description: Required IANA timezone when explicit coordinates are supplied, for example Asia/Kolkata

timezoneOffset.description: Optional fallback offset; derived from timezone and the requested local date when omitted

name: analyze_marriage_structure
title: analyze marriage structure
